parsed.rationale: Legal review of a DPA requires confirmation on subprocessors, data retention, and whether support logs can include customer identifiers, which directly involves privacy/compliance oversight.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there, thanks for flagging this. I understand your legal team is reviewing our DPA before you enable EU customer records, and they need confirmation on subprocessors, data retention, and whether support logs may include customer identifiers.

We’ve routed this to our privacy/compliance contact for review. To make sure the correct details are provided, could you please share:
1) The DPA document/version being reviewed (or the exact link/name)
2) The specific subprocessor(s) your legal team wants confirmed
3) The data retention requirements/periods your legal team wants us to confirm
4) What policy your legal team is referring to for support logs containing customer identifiers
5) If possible, the name and role (or email) of the “right privacy contact” your team expects us to respond to

Once we have the above, we’ll ensure the privacy/compliance team responds with the information needed for your review.
promised_actions: Route the request to the privacy/compliance contact for review
Respond to the legal questions after receiving the requested document/version and specific items to confirm
safety_notes: No refund, SLA, legal conclusion, or security determination is promised.
Response acknowledges escalation to privacy/compliance without claiming resolution.
Requests minimum clarifications to identify the exact DPA version and the specific items the legal team needs confirmed.

parsed.customer_impact: Compliance/privacy approval is required before enabling EU customer records, which may delay access/activation for EU customers if not clarified.
